references.text: God shows mercy to thousands of generations of those who love him and keep his commandments - the same promise of God's faithfulness to those who love him
The Lord declares his mercy and faithfulness, and that he holds fast to his kindness for a thousand generations
God is described as faithful and without injustice - confirming that the Lord is the faithful God
Nehemiah calls upon the great and awesome God who keeps covenant and shows mercy to those who love him and keep his commandments
God is referred to as the great, mighty, and awesome God who keeps covenant and shows steadfast love
God promises to preserve his mercy forever and keep his covenant faithfully
God remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded for a thousand generations
God gives food to those who fear him and remembers his covenant forever
Daniel confesses to the Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps covenant and shows mercy to those who love him and keep his commandments
God is faithful, he who called you into fellowship with his Son - confirming God's faithfulness
God is faithful and will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear - God's faithfulness toward his people
To love God is to keep his commandments - the connection between loving God and keeping his commands
